searchText: My apologies. I am unable to attend stand up. The meeting link from the calendar invite should work without me. Meeting still happening in 15 minutes. Someone please post the link. For this week's standup call (East), you can join using this link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82997806406?pwd=T1oxK2t3WFNzTkE4cG1nRmZ4WTdwUT09 tracing Hi everyone, I have created my first development update for my chosen project "Research on the removal of the Gas Stipend". I would appreciate any feedback 🙂 . Link: https://hackmd.io/@7s45VWTfS62Y7oet2jJOgQ/HyT36Tk4t Is this about removing something like `.call{gas: 3000}`? Is there analysis about breaking old contracts? (just curious) Oh I found this https://hackmd.io/@vbuterin/evm_feature_removing#Gas-visibility I think these are two different things. The think you link is about removing the `GAS` opcode, which removes the ability to observe how much gas is remaining for execution. The "Gas Stipend" is a different thing, where all CALL style operations receive a default stipend of 2300 gas for awkward legacy reasons. Also, West standup call in 45 minutes. Link will be posted prior to call. Hi all of you. Since I probably wont be able to attend the call today, I would like to know if anyone has experience running Curl from Mac. Trying to run -X POST ~./.../nethermind it keeps telling me error 32700 Please DM if you know. Thanks Can you paste the full command? It looks like you are giving inputs to “curl” your local filesystem which doesn’t really make sense Nethermind should expose a JSON-RPC endpoint you can interact with West Standup call: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89323407305?pwd=cnUvVmpKRTgzVWdpYWtTc3phTlNpQT09 Thanks. May I DM you ? CALL style operations and the `.call()` are two different things? 🤯 `.call()` does `CALL` I believe, but I can't remember whether the gas stipend applies to all of the CALL-style opcodes or just the specific CALL opcode (I think it is all of them) Sure There is a pattern/behavior that I've seen from a very small handful of program participants that I want to warn you all about. You are all free to label yourselves as "part of the Core Developer Apprenticeship Program". As I've said many times, there are no gates. Titles can sound impressive. But the reality is that titles don't mean much at all "here". Junior/Senior 🤷 Engineer/Developer/Student/TruckDriver 🤷‍♀️ Person/Dog/Dog-Person 🤷‍♂️ . You may be able to get some extra credibility by using this program as a way to acquire a fancier title or new resume item. But this may also backfire on you. It turns out people do sometimes check references. Everything in CDAP happens in the "open" and it is pretty easy to come and look at the work you've done (or not done) as part of the program. The best way to succeed here is to just do the work and do it well. So the gas stipend only applies to non-zero value transfers when the EVM interprets the opcodes CALL and CALLCODE. Probably good to just ignore any specifics I laid out there because I haven't looked closely at the EVM rules surrounding this recently.

You are all free to label yourselves as "part of the Core Developer Apprenticeship Program".  As I've said many times, there are no gates.  Titles can sound impressive.

You may be able to get some extra credibility by using this program as a way to acquire a fancier title or new resume item.  But this may also backfire on you.  It turns out people do sometimes check references.  Everything in CDAP happens in the "open" and it is pretty easy to come and look at the work you've done (or not done) as part of the program.  The best way to succeed here is to just do the work and do it well.
